content: अपमृत्युः [अपकृष्टो दुष्टहेतुजन्यत्वेन मृत्युः] .²1 Sudden or untimely death, accidental or unnatural death; भर्तृसक्तोऽपमृत्युस्तस्य संचरति <ls>Pt. 4</ls>. .²2 Any great danger, illness <ab>&c.</ab> from which a person, hopelessly given up for lost, recovers, quite contrary to expectation.
